topic: AI CERTs AI+ Engineer Practitioner (AT-330) certification exam preparation - a vendor-neutral applied-AI-engineering credential covering AI foundations and architecture, neural networks and their applications, large language models and generative AI, natural language processing, transfer learning with Hugging Face, building GUIs for AI solutions, and the AI communication and deployment pipeline
exam_format: Online, proctored exam with flexible scheduling: 50 multiple-choice and multiple-response questions, 90 minutes, passing score 70% (35/50). The bundle includes one free retake and a digital badge. IMPORTANT: AI CERTs delivers this as a TRAINING-PLUS-EXAM package and lists course prerequisites (completion of the AI+ Data Practitioner or AI+ Developer Practitioner course, plus basic Python) - there is no advertised standalone exam-only path, so this course is positioned as independent companion/concept prep, not a replacement for the official AI CERTs training. The ~$249 figure is an approximate exam-voucher estimate; bundle pricing via Authorized Training Partners is higher - confirm current pricing on the AI CERTs site.
question_types: multiple choice (single answer, exactly 4 options) and multiple select clearly marked as 'Select TWO/THREE'
audience: AI and software engineers, machine-learning enthusiasts, data scientists, IT specialists and system architects, and students or recent graduates who want to prove hands-on AI-engineering skills. Basic Python and high-school algebra/statistics are assumed. Complements the catalog's role-specific ML/GenAI engineer certs (AWS MLA-C01, Databricks ML/GenAI Engineer, IBM watsonx GenAI Engineer) with a broad, vendor-neutral 'AI Engineer' credential - cross-sell those plus the NVIDIA NCA-AMAD.
author: Aseem Mankotia

media.image_style: Clean modern tech illustration, AI-engineering theme (indigo/violet/cyan accents on dark slate), neural-network layers, transformer/attention motifs, data pipelines, model-serving and deployment imagery, abstract and professional, NO text, NO words, NO numbers, NO logos, NO brand marks

domains.name: Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
domains.notes: AT-330 domain 1: core AI/ML vocabulary and mental models - supervised/unsupervised/reinforcement learning, the ML workflow, and where modern AI engineering sits. Short foundational chapter.

domains.name: Introduction to AI Architecture
domains.notes: AT-330 domain 2: the architecture of AI systems - data layer, model layer, serving layer, feedback loops, and how components fit into an end-to-end AI application.

domains.name: Fundamentals of Neural Networks
domains.notes: AT-330 domain 3 (heaviest): perceptrons, layers, activation functions, forward/backprop, loss and optimization, training dynamics (overfitting, regularization) - the conceptual core.

domains.name: Applications of Neural Networks
domains.notes: AT-330 domain 4: CNNs for vision, RNNs/sequence models, and practical applications of neural networks across domains.

domains.name: Significance of Large Language Models (LLMs)
domains.notes: AT-330 domain 5: transformers and attention, pretraining vs fine-tuning, tokenization, context windows, and what makes LLMs powerful and where they fail.

domains.name: Application of Generative AI
domains.notes: AT-330 domain 6: applying generative AI - prompting, RAG, embeddings, diffusion/generative vision at a conceptual level, and designing GenAI features into products.

domains.name: Natural Language Processing
domains.notes: AT-330 domain 7 (heaviest): NLP pipeline - text preprocessing, embeddings, classification, NER, sentiment, and modern transformer-based NLP.

domains.name: Transfer Learning with Hugging Face
domains.notes: AT-330 domain 8 (heaviest): transfer learning in practice using the Hugging Face ecosystem - loading pretrained models, pipelines, fine-tuning, tokenizers, and the model hub. Most applied/hands-on chapter.

domains.name: Crafting Sophisticated GUIs for AI Solutions
domains.notes: AT-330 domain 9: building user interfaces for AI apps - Gradio/Streamlit-style app building, exposing models through a UI, and UX considerations for AI products.

domains.name: AI Communication and Deployment Pipeline
domains.notes: AT-330 domain 10: serving and shipping AI - APIs, containerization, model deployment, basic MLOps/monitoring, and communicating AI results to stakeholders.

extra_guidance: AI+ Engineer Practitioner (AT-330) from AI CERTs is a VENDOR-NEUTRAL applied-AI-engineering credential - 'AI Engineer' is a very high-demand Udemy keyword and this catalog has only role-specific ML/GenAI engineer certs, so this fills a broad gap. Exam facts: 50 multiple-choice/multiple-response questions, 90 minutes, 70% to pass (35/50), online proctored, one free retake, digital badge. Use the TEN official domains above with their OFFICIAL published weights (verbatim from the AI CERTs blueprint) - weight coverage toward the three 15% domains (Neural Networks, NLP, Transfer Learning with Hugging Face). Chapters map ~1:1 to the ten domains; chapter 1 adds the exam overview + AI-engineering workflow. POSITIONING/HONESTY (important): AT-330 is a training+exam bundle with course prerequisites (AI+ Data Practitioner or AI+ Developer Practitioner + basic Python) and no advertised exam-only path, so position this course plainly as independent companion/concept prep that builds the knowledge to pass - NOT a replacement for the official AI CERTs training, and note the assumed Python/math background in chapter 1 and the description. Ground content in real, teachable tools: Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow at a conceptual level, the Hugging Face transformers/datasets ecosystem (this is an explicit exam domain - cover it concretely), Gradio/Streamlit for the GUI domain, and standard deployment (FastAPI, Docker, basic MLOps). Labs are conceptual/architecture + lightweight code-walkthrough exercises (build a text classifier with a pretrained model, wire a Gradio UI to an LLM, design a deployment pipeline) - no paid cloud required. Final chapter = full 90-minute / 50-question / 70%-pass exam simulation with time-management strategy. Keep practice questions scenario-based with plausible distractors; scan the bank per the pipeline compliance rules (no 'guaranteed pass'/'first attempt' language). Marketing angle: 'Become a certified AI Engineer - complete, vendor-neutral prep covering neural networks, LLMs, NLP, Hugging Face transfer learning, and AI deployment.'
